title: Agentic Legacy Modernization
subtitle: Modern APIs and internal apps for the systems of record you already trust.
description: Modernize legacy workflows incrementally. Discover existing terminal, COBOL and SOAP/XML interfaces; describe their contracts; expose validated OpenAPI-compatible adapters and build usable React front ends while retaining the underlying system's business behavior.

hero.alt: Vintage computer terminal in a dim room

includes.title: Discover and understand
includes.blurb: Inventory existing interfaces before changing how people access them.
bullets: COBOL copybooks, VSAM and mainframe dataset interfaces
TN3270 terminal workflows and screen fields
SOAP/XML services, schemas and transaction boundaries
Source mapping with documented assumptions and constraints

includes.title: Wrap with modern contracts
includes.blurb: Preserve business behavior through controlled adapters.
bullets: REST/OpenAPI facades over existing services
Typed canonical JSON for request and response models
Input validation, authentication and audit trails
Explicit error handling and regression tests

includes.title: Give teams a usable front end
includes.blurb: Create interfaces around the existing systems of record.
bullets: React-based forms and process views
Identity-aware internal request workflows
Human approval for consequential steps
Incremental deployment without forced replacement

process.title: Inventory the contracts
process.blurb: Map existing transactions, message formats, dependencies and business rules. Define test fixtures and a safe integration boundary.

process.title: Wrap and validate
process.blurb: Generate adapters and OpenAPI descriptions, then compare output and error behavior with the legacy service using representative test cases.

process.title: Build and govern
process.blurb: Create a browser-based workflow with role-aware access, action logs, deployment documentation and an explicit review process.

cta.headline: Modernize access without rewriting the core
cta.blurb: Discuss a bounded legacy workflow and the right level of API wrapping, UI replacement and regression testing.
cta.chatPrompt: I want to modernize an existing terminal or SOAP/XML workflow using OpenAPI and an internal application.

metaDescription: Agentic legacy modernization for COBOL, mainframes, TN3270 and SOAP/XML interfaces. Preserve existing systems behind OpenAPI adapters and internal applications.

title: Agent UX Consulting
subtitle: Design agentic experiences users actually trust and complete.
description: Most agent failures aren't model failures — they're design failures. We help product teams design agentic experiences that recover from errors, disclose what they're doing, respect latency budgets, and don't overwhelm the user with what the model is thinking.

hero.alt: Designer workspace with sketches and a laptop

includes.title: What we cover
includes.blurb: The full surface area of an agentic product, not just the chat box.
bullets: Interaction patterns for autonomous and supervised agents
Disclosure design — what to show, what to hide, when to ask
Recovery from agent errors without losing user trust
Latency budgets that match what users will actually wait for

includes.title: What we deliver
includes.blurb: A working prototype plus the design system to extend it.
bullets: Annotated wireframes and interaction specs
A clickable prototype backed by a real model
A design system your team can extend without us
Recorded walkthrough of the design rationale

bullets: Internal tooling teams shipping agents to ops
Consumer products with an AI surface that feels off
B2B SaaS adding agent features to existing workflows
Founders about to ship an agent for the first time

title: SLM Feasibility & Savings
subtitle: 2–4 week paid assessment. Quality, $/year, go/no-go.
description: Before you commit to building, we take a sample of your actual workload, build a small model that handles it, and produce a written report with quality benchmarks vs. your current API, projected $/year savings at production volume, and a go/no-go recommendation. Most engagements pay back the assessment fee 50–100x in year one.

hero.alt: Analytics dashboard on a screen in a dark room

includes.title: What we measure
includes.blurb: The numbers you actually need to make a build / buy / stay decision.
bullets: Quality on your real eval set vs. your current API
P50 / P95 / P99 latency at projected production volume
Cost per 1k requests at 1x, 10x, and 100x current scale
Failure modes and the cost of getting them wrong

includes.title: What's in the report
includes.blurb: A 20–40 page document you can hand to your CFO.
bullets: Executive summary with go / no-go recommendation
Side-by-side quality benchmarks on your data
Three-year cost projection under realistic assumptions
A concrete deployment plan if the answer is "go"

includes.title: How we de-risk it
includes.blurb: You don't pay the full fee unless we believe the numbers work.
bullets: Week 1: a 48-hour sniff test on a small sample
No-fee exit if the workload isn't a fit
Fixed-fee engagement — no surprise invoices
NDA and data residency handled upfront

process.title: Train

process.title: Report

title: SLM Deployments

Edge — automotive, retail, factory floor, mobile
